channel.title: The Reassuring Universe
channel.description: A personal collection of essays on purpose, spirit, and everyday wonder, organized by theme.

item.title: Soul Music I
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray on children hearing live music for the first time, and the change it might plant.

item.title: Soul Music II
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: An essay by Don Ray on musical instruments and musicians as engineers building bridges between souls.

item.title: Bridges of Sound and Light
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray on music, painting, and poetry as fragile bridges built to connect one soul to another.

item.title: Terlingua
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray on a Texas ghost town's cemetery, church, and store, and the honesty of a place with no pretense.

item.title: Blanket Man
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: An essay by Don Ray on a homeless man who sat under blankets for years, and what his fate says about the rest of us.

item.title: Pre-dawn Ragged Blanket
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short reflective essay by Don Ray on tempering the overwhelming intensity of life, if only until dawn.

item.title: Childish Questions
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray on the honest questions children ask, and the madness we learn to stop noticing.

item.title: The Curse of Approval
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: An essay by Don Ray on the hunger for approval that drives so much of what we do, and the cat's example of not caring.

item.title: Material Separation
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray on how errands, possessions, and maintenance quietly steal the time meant for relationship.

item.title: Antithetical Societal Solution
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: An essay by Don Ray on a rare quiet Saturday morning, and contemplation as a quietly subversive act.

item.title: Digital Storm
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short poem by Don Ray on the digital storm of manipulation that overwhelmed us before we were ready.

item.title: Digital Disruption
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: An essay by Don Ray on digital disruption, superficial connection, and the reassurance still available through it.

item.title: Machine Mirrors
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: An essay by Don Ray on what our hours spent staring at screens reveal about the human spirit.

item.title: Trust Your Robot
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray on empathy robots, and our desperation to be heard by anyone, or anything, that will listen.

item.title: Mindfield
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray on belief as the real battlefield behind divorce, riots, and war.

item.title: Digitally Fractured Beliefs
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: An essay by Don Ray on how digital media shattered the shared belief that once held neighbors and nations together.

item.title: Digital Migrations
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: An essay by Don Ray tracing 100,000 years of human grouping to ask what our new digital migrations are building.

item.title: Artificial Intelligence and Real Stupidity
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray on belief wielded as a weapon, and what technology can and cannot save us from.

item.title: Judgement Daze
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: An essay by Don Ray on the daily flood of media-fed judgment of others, and the judgment it invites on ourselves.

item.title: Many Truths
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: An essay by Don Ray on the seductive, isolating claim that there are “many truths.”

item.title: Overlapping Realities
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray on the ungrounded, overlapping realities we each construct, and the conflict they cause.

item.title: Reality Gap
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: An essay by Don Ray on how expectation, not evidence, shapes what we see, and what that demands of us.

item.title: Small World
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray on how the felt size of the world, and the weight of our judgments, are really just reflections of our own perspective.

item.title: Oblivious to the Obvious
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: An essay by Don Ray on the willful, cultivated madness of self-destructive populism, and the values worth preserving when it takes hold.

item.title: No Time for Grief
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A poem by Don Ray on holding fast to what's precious as the world's facades and certainties come apart.

item.title: Inevitable War?
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: An essay by Don Ray asking whether war is truly inevitable, or a freely chosen evil we keep choosing.

item.title: For the Children
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: An essay by Don Ray imagining negotiations built around what warring parties actually want for their children.

item.title: Impact of Refugees
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray on the refugee crisis, and the question it leaves for those of us who are safe.

item.title: Syrian Ceasefire
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: An essay by Don Ray written in the minutes surrounding a declared Syrian ceasefire, on the choice it represents.

item.title: Crumbling Temples, Crumbling Lessons
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray, written on a train leaving Rome, imagining the last priest of a Roman temple cult facing a faith no one needed anymore.

item.title: The Bass Voice of God
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray questioning why God would need masks, altars, guilt, or amplifiers to reach us, and who is really being called by the bass voice of a subwoofer.

item.title: Faith Crisis, Faith Freedom
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: An essay by Don Ray on the wrenching, ultimately liberating crisis of faith that comes from admitting a belief was wrong.

item.title: In Need of Meadow
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A field-journal essay by Don Ray on a quiet meadow, and the perspective it offers away from the tangle of society.

item.title: Coyote Creation
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short field-journal essay by Don Ray on a coyote mother's morning run to her hidden pups.

item.title: The Fledging of Downy Woodpeckers
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A field-journal essay by Don Ray on watching four downy woodpecker chicks fledge, one anxious flight at a time.

item.title: Coyote Tales and Red Moon Omen
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A field-journal essay by Don Ray pairing coyote pups at play with an ominous red moon.

item.title: Our Nature
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: An essay by Don Ray on humanity's long war with Nature, and the fragile new chance to love it instead.

item.title: Alate Assist
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A field-journal essay by Don Ray on a struggling flying ant, and the small assist that let it rise.

item.title: Ripples in Time
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: An essay by Don Ray on a dead insect on the back of his hand, and the unseen ripples every choice leaves in time.

item.title: Contact Eternity
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray on the enduring, rippling influence of every small human contact.

item.title: Enduring Consciousness
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray: the only thing that has endured throughout our entire lives is our individual consciousness, so why do we invest nothing in it?

item.title: Cynical Encouragement
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: An essay by Don Ray weighing cynical realism against hope, after a day spent researching tires.

item.title: Whispering Hope
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: An essay by Don Ray on the noise of the modern world, and the enduring, whispering Hope beneath it.

item.title: Unnatural Peace
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: An essay by Don Ray on peace as an unnatural, evolutionarily inexplicable longing worth trusting anyway.

item.title: Destructive Gentleness
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: An essay by Don Ray questioning whether gentleness has any place in a world built on toughness.

item.title: Tracer Bullets Over Your Life-Path
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray on following your life's path as scrambling forward under tracer bullets, not marching in lockstep.

item.title: Spark of Progress
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: An essay by Don Ray on the rare sparks of human potential that occasionally overcome fear and prejudice.

item.title: At the Ranch
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray: a horse grooming two piglets becomes a glimpse into the secrets of Nature, and a reason not to hurry.

item.title: Frantic
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray: watching a fledgling robin's chaotic first day out of the nest, and wondering if we left our own nest too soon.

item.title: Deer and Coyotes
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A field-journal essay by Don Ray on deer, a family of coyote pups, and what it means for consciousness to briefly overlap.

item.title: Hillside
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray: angels tending an ordinary hillside, and what it feels like when a moment refuses to hurry.

item.title: Seeing Through Our Dreams and Scars
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A meditation by Don Ray on what age and youth each distort, and on trusting a kind of seeing that doesn't depend on the eyes.

item.title: A Higher Perspective
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray: a dying winged ant prompts a meditation on meaning, purpose, and the limits of what we can ever know of either.

item.title: Summary of Life
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray: the realistic graduation speech no one gives, and the freedom hidden inside life's constraints.

item.title: What's Left After Conforming
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray on the tension between being true to yourself and getting by in the world, and what's left once you subtract the conforming.

item.title: Winning with the Stacked Deck of Life
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: An essay by Don Ray on the cards we're dealt in body, mind, and emotion, and the freedom we still have in how we choose to play them.

item.title: Did We Love?
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray on the time-consuming details of daily life, and the two questions that echo beneath them: were we loved, and did we love?

item.title: Our Actions: Coerced; Compelled; Chosen
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray on three levels of human action: survival, connection, and freely chosen, selfless Love.

item.title: Our Ancient Birth
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray on spiritual birth and Choice as ancient, ongoing, and older than any single religion's words for them.

item.title: Inexorable Life
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray: life and growth flow inevitably, like a river, however our choices shape the course along the way.

item.title: Stream of Consciousness
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray: there is only consciousness, flowing through a physical world that exists to connect us to each other and to the Whole.

item.title: Impossible Yearning
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray on the human longing for Unity and Communion, and why it's better placed in Source than in any person or institution.

item.title: Knowledge of Good and Evil
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray on the Garden of Eden story as necessary embodiment for real moral experience.

item.title: Would We Miss Death
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray imagining a life without demands or death, and asking what that would reveal about who we really are.

item.title: Terrifying Passage from the Garden to the Kin'dom
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray imagining existence without fear or pain, and what that reveals about what fear and pain make possible in us.

item.title: The Scrum of Perfection
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray: life as an unfair scrum from which the Light of Beauty and Love still arise.

item.title: Beauty in the Madness
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray on finding beauty in the persistent madness of the human condition, viewed from a contemplative distance.

item.title: Faith Madness
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray on the sense and senselessness of living by faith rather than by worldly practicality.

item.title: Fledging
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray: this world as an iron pot boiling toward a feast of purified love that never goes to waste.

item.title: Storm of Creation
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A poem by Don Ray: creation, like a storm, arrives as disruption — turn and face it, and let it in.

item.title: Dark Matter and the Light of Love
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray: Love as the weakest force in human affairs, and the one that, like gravity, quietly holds everything together.

item.title: Forgiving God
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray asking whether it's God, not us, who needs forgiving for the constraints of this life, and what still arises in spite of them.

item.title: The Inevitable and the Certain
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray: the holy and pure will inevitably be sullied in this world, but Resurrection in its many forms is just as certain.

item.title: Apprenticed to God
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray on learning to create by being apprenticed, in this imperfect world, to the Creator.

item.title: Pray Alone, That You May Love Together
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray on contemplative prayer as the way past the limits of our immediate community, so we can love more freely within it.

item.title: Currency of the Soul
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A poem by Don Ray: patience and faith as the currency the soul spends, and compassion as the return that never disappoints.

item.title: Three Principles
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray distilling faith and practice down to three guiding principles: unity, embodied worship, and the underlying force of Love.

item.title: Shadow Embrace
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A poem by Don Ray on shadows as projections of a hidden perfection, awaiting the timeless merging of past and future.

item.title: Overlapping Projections of Gods
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short poem by Don Ray on individual consciousness as a soft, flexible light without this world's hard edges of conflict.

item.title: Silken Tide
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray: the ebb and flow of Presence, too gentle to intrude on our noises and plans, slipping in and out like a silken tide.

item.title: Breeze of Mystery
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A poem by Don Ray: pure poetry over prose to gesture at the Mystery — a breeze brushing the skin, undoubtedly there, uncompromisingly invisible.

item.title: Alternative Path Home
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray: a squirrel blocked from its usual path finds another way home, and a lesson about holding the goal fixed while the path changes.

item.title: Flightless Souls on Walkabout
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray: flightless ducks wandering from the safety of their pond, and what their dangerous walkabouts say about our own restless souls.

item.title: Recognizing Beauty
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray: a barely-running creek, a coyote concert, and the case that a cold indifference to Nature's beauty is companion to a cold indifference to humanity.

item.title: Stop for a Moment
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray on the lost riches of quiet and stillness, and how busyness has crowded out awareness of the greater Self.

item.title: Portal of Your Soul
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A poem by Don Ray urging the lost and busy to listen, in the moments before sleep, for the music entering through the portal of the soul.

item.title: Save the World a Little Later
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray inviting the reader to a moment of rest — peace that can be carried back into the world, which will still be there to save.

item.title: Conversation with an angel
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray talking back to an angel's “fear not” — impractical advice, and the case that going on anyway is faith enough.

item.title: The Death of Personal Growth
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray: personal growth requires change, and change is a form of death of our existing self.

item.title: Successful Disaster
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray: worldly disasters entangled with spiritual miracles, and grandiose plans slowly waning in submission to The Grandiose Plan.

item.title: Life Adrift or Navigating Life
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray: the enticing shallow waters of the familiar shore, and what it takes to sail with resolve though we know not our destination.

item.title: Heart Blindness
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray, written outside an office while waiting with grieving friends, on the blindness that leaves us gasping at each ripped discontinuity in life.

item.title: Ghost of Perfection
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A poem by Don Ray on glimpsing perfection in a flutter of wing or passing breeze, gone as soon as seen.

item.title: Conveniently Rational Munitions
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A poem by Don Ray on the world's churning engine of excused cruelty, and the small, unbefitting sparks of compassion that restrain it.

item.title: Unlocked Door of our Solitary Confinement
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray: the little self dancing alone in solitary confinement, until consciousness begins to incorporate someone or something else.

item.title: You Will Be Touched
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A poem by Don Ray assuring the distant and defended reader that Love will find them, gently, in its own time.

item.title: Edge
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A poem by Don Ray on the liminal peace at the edge of this temporal world, reached only by searching within.

item.title: Pachinko Minds
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray: our minds rattle through a pachinko path of development, shaped by chance and circumstance, yet the aggregate result is majestic.

item.title: Symphony of Chance
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A poem by Don Ray on chimes struck by chance, each tone perfect in itself, composing a symphony no one performs.

item.title: More Than Meat
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A long essay by Don Ray comparing the sexual revolution's openness to our continuing silence about personal, intimate spiritual experience.

item.title: That Person Next to You
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A poem by Don Ray: no experience comes closer to knowing God than an inter-human interaction, none can drive us further away.

item.title: Worship
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A poem by Don Ray: worship stripped of totems and liturgy — alone, honest, and directed at the questions themselves.

item.title: Truth.....Any Takers?
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A poem by Don Ray on all the reasons we talk ourselves out of wanting eternal Truth delivered to our doorstep.

item.title: Lessons of the Mystery
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A poem by Don Ray on life's private, unrepeatable lessons, and a Mystery that welcomes our clumsy explorations of it.

item.title: Intention of Attention
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay and poem by Don Ray on the discipline of consciousness, and how attention carries with it the responsibility of intention.

item.title: Question Revealing Truth
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray on the Christos each of us imprints on in childhood, and the heart's question that testifies to a shared Truth.

item.title: Shock Prayer
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A one-paragraph prayer by Don Ray asking to be shocked out of complacency and the status quo.

item.title: Painful Prayer
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray on why contemplative prayer is a discipline rather than something easy and automatic.

item.title: Accept What You Want
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray on why God withholds detailed answers, preserving the freedom that makes us children of God.

item.title: Personalized Scripture
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray on a Lectionary study group, and why scripture's power lies in personal, not absolute, interpretation.

item.title: Boring Angels
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray on why relationships with angels lack reciprocity, and why Unity requires kindred, changeable spirits instead.

item.title: Temporally Senseless
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray on Yeshu's radical teachings, and how the eternal and the temporal make no sense in each other's terms.

item.title: Defiant-Subversive-Seditious Christmas
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray on Christmas carols, and a Love triumphant enough to shine through the dung and blood of the world.

item.title: Palm Sunday Anti-Climax
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray on the world's fleeting, uncommitted glance at the Christ, endlessly repeated since that first Palm Sunday.

item.title: Do Not Cling to the Light
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A poem by Don Ray on Mary Magdalene at the empty tomb, and the admonition not to cling to a Light the world isn't yet ready for.

item.title: Powerless Triumph
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray on personal power as the antithesis of spiritual Unity, and the Lamb whose surrender of power set it free.

item.title: Following the Unseeable
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray on following a calling and God's will, knowing both will be obscured and contradictory.

item.title: Indefensible Hope
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray on a hope rooted beyond time, needing no worldly reason and no defense.

item.title: Collapse of Worldly Wisdom
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray on the moments when worldly wisdom breaks down, revealing the Void between this world and the Kindom.

item.title: Role of a Life in the Purpose of Life
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray questioning whether one ordinary life can matter to God's unfolding Purpose.

item.title: Ontological Meaning of Salvation
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray on the necessary isolation of a newly conscious self, and Salvation as the Choice to reach back through the Void.

item.title: Heaven With a Little Help From Me Friends
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray, prompted by Joe Cocker's death, on whether Heaven simply liberates the true self hidden by pain and fear.

item.title: Combat and Compassion
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray on people as programmed as any cat or dog, and spiritual practice as liberation from that programming.

item.title: Just a Moment
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A poem by Don Ray on refusing to let a warm, ordinary moment slip away for the sake of goals and objectives.

item.title: Another Fresh Start
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A poem by Don Ray on the strange liberation of hopelessness — a clean slate after every plan has failed.

item.title: Mere Faith to Move Mountains
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A poem by Don Ray on faith purified by repeated failure, building not a mountain to be moved but one to be built.

item.title: Incarnationalism
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A poem by Don Ray on the blindness of the corporeal mind, and the Light that shows through its unraveling threads.

item.title: Laughs of Grass
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short poem by Don Ray on golden grass, still beautiful crisp and spent as it was fresh and green.

item.title: Freedom From Opportunity
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A poem by Don Ray on what's revealed of us only in the absence of opportunity, when left to our own devices.

item.title: Cuddling and Carnivores
item.dc:creator: Don Ray
item.description: A short essay by Don Ray: affection for pigs being raised to be eaten, and what that says about awareness inside necessity.
